general_guidance.guidance: The apparatus criticus notes are organized by line number in the main text. Words in italics indicate the lemma or variant reading under discussion; words in roman type are editorial remarks and include bibliographical references (generally in parentheses), manuscript sigla, and symbols for editions. The apparatus criticus in this edition is positive, meaning that it reports the lemma, evidence for the lemma, variant readings, and evidence for the variant readings. Moreover, the variants are reported in a comma-separated list in descending order of preference, with the most preferred reading listed first. If there is more than one apparatus criticus note for a given line, the notes are separated by a period.
